products.name: Enablement Kit — Identity Modernization with Entra — Commercial
products.short_description: Upskill your team to modernize identity on Entra — a self-guided enablement kit with concepts, hands-on labs, and a take-home runbook.
products.description:
Upskill your team to modernize identity on Entra — a self-guided enablement kit with concepts, hands-on labs, and a take-home runbook.

Modernizing from legacy AD/AD FS to a Zero Trust Entra identity fails when the team doesn't understand the target state. This enablement kit teaches identity modernization on Microsoft Entra — the journey, the building blocks (CA, Identity Protection, passwordless, governance, GSA), and guided hands-on labs — so your admins can drive the modernization confidently.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Concepts — the legacy→modern identity journey and target-state architecture
  • Guided hands-on labs across CA, Identity Protection, passwordless, governance
  • Migration & coexistence patterns (AD FS/hybrid → cloud)
  • A take-home modernization runbook and knowledge-check
  • Sample scripts / KQL for validation and reporting

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A team that can confidently modernize your identity estate on Entra — concepts internalized, labs completed, and a runbook to execute.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 4 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • EKIDMOD-Discovery.ps1 — Read-only baseline of the identity-modernization posture
    • EKIDMOD-LabSetup.ps1 — Safe, preview-first helper to create/remove the pilot lab scope
    • EKIDMOD-Report.ps1 — Modernization scorecard exported to CSV + HTML (read-only)
    • EKIDMOD-Validate.ps1 — Read-only check that the enablement-lab prerequisites are met

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
